backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling taxi pickups, customers, user profiles, access control, and storage with CRUD-style operations and security checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping regression fixes and UI hardening tasks to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point creating the root container and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing authentication, initialization flow, and routing between login, setup, and main app screens.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Modal dialog showing application information, copyright details, and contact info.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Wrapper component that blocks rendering until the backend actor is ready, showing loading or error states as needed.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: A searchable combobox component that fetches and displays customer suggestions and lets users select or create a customer.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: A dialog that fetches and displays the current cycle balance with refresh capability and formatted cycle units.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: A report dialog that selects a date range, fetches pickups, deduplicates them, groups by date, and computes daily totals and summaries.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: A confirmation dialog that deletes all stored records using a mutation and shows status and error toasts.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: A dialog allowing users to view, edit, or delete pickups for a selected date, including form population and update/delete mutations.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: A dialog for editing driver profile details with validation, form state, and profile update mutation.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Dialog component handling JSON data export with deduplication and import preview/validation workflow.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying © notice and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Dialog that opens a print window and generates a formatted PDF-like document of application specifications.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation header with theme toggle, profile actions, and multiple feature dialogs such as reports and export/import.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Form for recording a pickup with customer lookup, auto-population, and submission via mutation.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Displays daily pickups, computes totals by payment method, and formats timestamps for listing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wraps useActor to expose simplified readiness state and a refetch trigger.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and login state, including loading stored identities and initiating login flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, pickups, and customer data using an authenticated backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS base styles and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React application, wrapping it with query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Implements a profile setup form allowing users to create or update their driver information with validation and backend saving.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login screen with Internet Identity login and theme toggle support.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for a login method selection page.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main application layout showing a pickup form and a list of pickups filtered by date.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Provides a helper to extract a consistent error message string from unknown error objects.
frontend/src/utils/numberFormat.ts: Contains safe number formatting utilities for currency, fixed decimals, and parsing.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Calculates how much money is owed to a driver based on meter totals and tips.
frontend/src/utils/pickupGuards.ts: Utility functions that safely convert between bigint nanosecond timestamps, Date objects, and HH:MM strings with fallbacks for invalid inputs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and container settings while enabling typography, container query, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing a regression causing blank screens when editing records and listing related fix requirements and known issues.
